finding: No significant arm effect internally (0/12). Externally, 9/24 significant, split roughly evenly confirming vs. disconfirming (5 vs 4) once classified by which specific metric was significant. Eight of the significant results are on bus_uclm (n=629); the remaining one is on breast (n=256). sensitivity90 never reaches significance anywhere in this table; only macro_f1 ever does. Overall: inconclusive on the Clever Hans hypothesis -- neither confirmed nor disconfirmed.
